import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import activity_contributions as a
os.environ['SENSITIVITY_OUTPUT']=str(a.HERE/'runs')
sys.path.insert(0,str(a.HERE.parent/'born-form-diagnosis'))
import p1
s=p1.d.s
s.verify_wheel()
a.d=p1.d
a.pure=np.array([float(c=='water') for c in s.COMPONENT_IDS])
a.pressures=list(s.REACTION_REFERENCE_PRESSURES.values())
inputs=json.loads((a.HERE/'inputs.json').read_text())
mapping=s.parameter_mapping(Path(inputs['records']['adopted']))
refit=s.parameter_mapping(Path(inputs['records']['off-refit']))
record=json.loads((a.HERE/'runs/adopted-states.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()[0])
T, liquid=record['T'],record['liquid']
x=np.array(liquid['mole_fractions']); P=liquid['pressure_pa']
on=a.mixture(mapping); off_mapping=p1.without_born(mapping); off=a.mixture(off_mapping)
anchor=on.state(T,rho=liquid['molar_density_mol_m3'],x=x)
base=off.state(T,P=P,x=x,phase='liquid',anchor=anchor)
q0=a.activities(off,T,base,x)[2]
values=s.parameter_values(refit); old=s.parameter_values(mapping)
result=dict(state=record['identity'],T_K=T,P_Pa=P,x=x.tolist(),anchor_rho_mol_m3=anchor.molar_density,off_baseline_rho_mol_m3=base.molar_density,Q_off=q0,attempts=[])
for identity in p1.d.IDS:
    changed=s.with_parameter_values(off_mapping,{identity:values[identity]})
    model=a.mixture(changed)
    probe=model.state(T,rho=anchor.molar_density,x=x)
    attempt=dict(coordinate=identity,old_value=old[identity],new_value=values[identity],mapping_fingerprint=s.parameter_fingerprint(changed),pressure_at_anchor_Pa=probe.pressure,Z_at_anchor=probe.compressibility_factor)
    try:
        state=model.state(T,P=P,x=x,phase='liquid',anchor=anchor)
        attempt.update(rho_mol_m3=state.molar_density,delta_Q=a.activities(model,T,state,x)[2]-q0)
    except Exception as error:
        attempt.update(exception=type(error).__name__,message=str(error))
        result['attempts'].append(attempt)
        s.write_json(a.HERE/'c2-density-failure.json',result)
        print(json.dumps(result,indent=2)); break
    result['attempts'].append(attempt)
else:
    raise RuntimeError('C2 density failure not reproduced')

import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import activity_contributions as a
os.environ['SENSITIVITY_OUTPUT']=str(a.HERE/'runs')
sys.path.insert(0,str(a.HERE.parent/'born-form-diagnosis'))
import p1
s=p1.d.s; s.verify_wheel(); a.d=p1.d
request=p1.d.OBS[0]['request']['reaction_system']
a.matrix=np.array(request['reaction_matrix'])
a.pure=np.array([float(c=='water') for c in s.COMPONENT_IDS])
a.pressures=list(s.REACTION_REFERENCE_PRESSURES.values())
inputs=json.loads((a.HERE/'inputs.json').read_text())
mapping=s.parameter_mapping(Path(inputs['records']['adopted']))
refit=s.parameter_mapping(Path(inputs['records']['off-refit']))
records=[r for r in map(json.loads,(a.HERE/'runs/adopted-states.jsonl').open()) if 'co2-partial-pressure' in r['predictions']]
on=a.mixture(mapping); off_mapping=p1.without_born(mapping); off=a.mixture(off_mapping)
values=s.parameter_values(refit); old=s.parameter_values(mapping)
models=[a.mixture(s.with_parameter_values(off_mapping,{identity:values[identity]})) for identity in p1.d.IDS]
joint=a.mixture(s.with_parameter_values(off_mapping,{identity:values[identity] for identity in p1.d.IDS}))
result=dict(total_pressure_states=len(records),states=[],failure=None)
for rec in records:
    T, liquid=rec['T'],rec['liquid']; x=np.array(liquid['mole_fractions']); P=liquid['pressure_pa']
    anchor=on.state(T,rho=liquid['molar_density_mol_m3'],x=x)
    base=off.state(T,P=P,x=x,phase='liquid',anchor=anchor)
    q0=a.activities(off,T,base,x)[2]
    local=dict(state=rec['identity'],T_K=T,P_Pa=P,x=x.tolist(),anchor_rho_mol_m3=anchor.molar_density,off_baseline_rho_mol_m3=base.molar_density,Q_off=q0,attempts=[])
    for identity, model in zip(p1.d.IDS,models,strict=True):
        attempt=dict(coordinate=identity,old_value=old[identity],new_value=values[identity])
        try:
            state=model.state(T,P=P,x=x,phase='liquid',anchor=anchor)
            attempt.update(rho_mol_m3=state.molar_density,delta_Q=a.activities(model,T,state,x)[2]-q0)
        except Exception as error:
            probe=model.state(T,rho=anchor.molar_density,x=x)
            attempt.update(exception=type(error).__name__,message=str(error),pressure_at_anchor_Pa=probe.pressure,Z_at_anchor=probe.compressibility_factor,mapping_fingerprint=s.parameter_fingerprint(s.with_parameter_values(off_mapping,{identity:values[identity]})))
            result['failure']=dict(state=rec['identity'],T_K=T,P_Pa=P,**attempt)
            local['attempts'].append(attempt); break
        local['attempts'].append(attempt)
    if result['failure'] is None:
        state=joint.state(T,P=P,x=x,phase='liquid',anchor=anchor)
        local['all_coordinates_delta_Q']=a.activities(joint,T,state,x)[2]-q0
    result['states'].append(local)
    if result['failure'] is not None: break
result['unattempted_pressure_states']=len(records)-len(result['states'])
s.write_json(a.HERE/'c2-density-failure.json',result)
assert result['failure'] is not None, 'C2 density failure not reproduced'
print(json.dumps(result['failure'],indent=2))
